notes: v0.19.3: Quest Documents/Logs read-only folder permission is now the DEFAULT player tracking method; Shizuku is no longer required on Quest for the folder mode. Quest setup prominently requests folder permission and opens the Android picker when needed. The existing Shizuku Quest option remains available only in Tracking controls > Advanced tools > Alternative Quest method as a fallback, with no automatic fallback or silent replay. Existing explicit Shizuku selections are preserved until switched; upgrades from the old default request folder access first. Android PHONE player tracking still REQUIRES Shizuku with the existing protected-log watcher. Existing staff verification, SQLite outbox, Relay upload, GM4/GM1 invitation authority, phone floater and Quest tools are unchanged. No Main Launcher or Relay deployment changes.
